timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1543 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently very weak, with the USD/KRW rate at a 17-year high of 1543 won per dollar. News describes a "strong dollar" (강달러) in an uptrend ("high-flying" 고공행진), meaning you need significantly more won to get $2,000 than in recent history.

TIP: If possible, consider dollar-cost averaging smaller amounts across multiple weeks in July, as SK Hainetix's $3 billion US listing may inject supply and potentially ease won weakness.
